title: Replay should never repeat an external mutation.
hook: Replay should never repeat an external mutation.
thesis: The technical position: replay reconstructs decisions from the journal; it must never re-execute external mutations as a side effect of replaying. Decision replay and mutation replay are different operations, and uncertain effects reconcile instead of repeating. The hook is earned by failure-injection evidence: kill at the listed points, restart, and show the journal proving the mutation was not repeated while the decision was faithfully reconstructed.

proven: The directive states the decision-replay vs mutation-replay distinction (section 6).
partial: Kill-point failure injection is implemented and exercised.
unknown: Recorded kill-and-restart runs with journal evidence suitable for publication.

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
